solution.text:
Higher the lattice enthalpy lower will be solubility

i.e., lattice enthalpy ∝1Solubility

Since the lattice enthalpy of alkali metals follow the order

Li>Na>K>Rb

Hence the correct order of solubility is

LiF<NaF<KF<RbF
